$description: Closed asset-role / destination-role registry. Roles used in PageSpec fields are exactly these names; policies are pinned (extraction/verify_all.py PINNED_POLICIES) so a role cannot silently be moved to a different-but-valid policy.
legalNotice: primefold.ai is a live commercial site (README: 'built for reference and study. Not for public deployment'). Nothing in public/assets may be shipped in a generated page for any other owner without verified rights.

assetRoles.generationGuidance: Use the owner's own exact logo files. Never redraw, recolour or 'improve' the mark.
assetRoles.licensingGuidance: Primefold's own marks: reuse only on pages owned by the same company. Do not ship them on another brand's page.

assetRoles.licensingGuidance: Owner's identity assets; reuse only for the owner.

assetRoles.licensingGuidance: Generic UI glyphs; the extracted originals are still the site owner's artwork, so draw new ones rather than copying files for other owners. Third-party brand colour exception: LinkedIn glyph uses rgb(9,102,194).

assetRoles.generationGuidance: Small decorative full-colour SVG tiles (security tiles, orbit source icons, stat tiles). Generate new original artwork in the same duotone style.
assetRoles.licensingGuidance: Contains no third-party marks except the German flag tile (public-domain national flag).

formEndpointRoles.generationGuidance: The source forms are INERT: submit is preventDefault'ed and nothing is sent anywhere, so there is no endpoint value to copy. A PageSpec form carries endpoint='project-owned-placeholder'; the implementing project wires its own backend.
formEndpointRoles.licensingGuidance: The live primefold.ai forms are real Framer-hosted submit endpoints that were never cloned; never add or guess them. Collecting real personal data (name, work email, phone, message) to someone else's endpoint is a privacy risk.

Widely distributed open-source family; confirm the licence text before redistributing.

TRIAL licence ('Trial' in the family name). A trial font is for evaluation only: it must not be shipped in production or in a redistributed package; purchase the commercial licence or replace it with a licensed face. Used for outcome digits, intelligence-card titles and phone hero/testimonial titles.

realIdentities.$description: Deny-list for fields flagged placeholderOnly in section contracts. Generated PageSpecs must not contain any of these strings (whole-word, case-insensitive) in those fields. 'people' (full names) match whole-word anywhere in the field; 'peopleFirstNamesOnly' match only when the entire field value equals the name, so common first names do not reject unrelated placeholder text.

realProprietaryCopyRule: Third-party-attributed copy (customer quotes, outcome claims such as '5x', '150 customers', '1 hour', named testimonials) must be replaced by clearly generic placeholder text in generated output. Primefold's own marketing copy is documented in the example only because the home example reproduces the owner's own page.
